home.title: Financial Accounts
home.createOrEditLabel: Create or edit a Financial Account

financialAccount.created: A new Financial Account is created with identifier {{ param }}
financialAccount.updated: A Financial Account is updated with identifier {{ param }}
financialAccount.deleted: A Financial Account is deleted with identifier {{ param }}

delete.title: Permanently delete account
delete.warning: This permanently deletes the financial data associated with this account and cannot be undone.
delete.previewFailed: Could not load deletion information. Close this dialog and try again.
delete.disabledExplanation: Permanent deletion is available only after deletion information has loaded and blockers are resolved.
delete.failed: This account could not be deleted. Try again.

removes.title: Will be permanently deleted
removes.empty: This account has no associated financial history.

preserves.title: Will be preserved
preserves.copy: Your categories and tags are not deleted. Budgets, subscriptions, and rules are preserved; anything requiring your attention before deletion appears below.

deactivate.title: Only want to stop using it?
deactivate.copy: You can deactivate the account and keep all of its history.

blockers.title: This account cannot be deleted yet

crossAccountTransfer.one: This account participates in 1 transfer with another account. Resolve that transfer before deleting it.
crossAccountTransfer.other: This account participates in {{count}} transfers with other accounts. Resolve those transfers before deleting it.

blockers.budgetScopeWouldBroaden: A budget uses this account as its only specific account. Deleting it would broaden that budget to all active accounts. Edit the budget first.
blockers.ruleAccountConditionReference: A rule uses this account as a condition. Edit or remove that condition before deleting the account.
blockers.corruptCandidate: Fintrack detected inconsistent transaction data associated with this account. It cannot be deleted safely.
blockers.corruptIngestionGraph: Fintrack detected inconsistent import data associated with this account. It cannot be deleted safely.
blockers.unsupportedApiImportCandidate: This account contains API import data that does not yet support permanent deletion.

financialAccount.name: Name

initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.DEBIT: Amount available when you started tracking this account. Negative values represent overdraft or a negative balance.
initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.CASH: Cash on hand when you started tracking. Negative values can represent an adjustment or negative cash position.
initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.CREDIT_CARD: Use a positive number if you owed money, or a negative number if you had credit in your favor. This is not your credit limit.
initialBalanceHelpByAccountType.INVESTMENT: Account value when you started tracking. Detailed investment valuation is deferred.

status.label: Status
status.help: Inactive accounts keep their history and balance, but cannot be selected for new transactions, imports, or rules until reactivated.
status.inactiveExplanation: This account is inactive. Its history and balance remain available, and existing work can finish, but it cannot be selected for new transactions, imports, or rules until it is reactivated.

financialAccount.creditLimitHelp: Maximum approved credit line for this card.
financialAccount.statementDayHelp: Day of the month when the statement period closes.
financialAccount.paymentDueDayHelp: Day of the month when payment is due.
financialAccount.annualInterestRateHelp: Annual percentage interest rate. Used later for interest calculations.

configured.saveError: The account could not be saved. Review the account and credit-card details and try again.

financialAccount.creditDetailsMissing: Credit card details have not been configured yet.
